title: Agents keyboard · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 25 Nov. Problems: move between the sessions tree, the transcript and the composer; switch sessions fast. Shared by all three directions: ⌃⌘1–9 open the N-th visible session (⌃⌘↓ order), ⌃⌘J the next one that needs you; every jump lands in the prompt, so ⌃⌘J then 1 = go there and allow once. ⌃⌘ instead of ⌥⌘ for numbers: without ⌘, ⌥1 would answer a card.
A · Ring: ⌃⇥ / ⌃⇧⇥ step through the panes (tree → transcript → composer → aside), the key macOS uses to leave a text field. Esc still stops the turn.

B · Modes: Esc steps out instead of stopping (composer → transcript → tree → composer); ⌘. stops the turn from any pane, Mac and iPad. The tree's j/k, h/l, g… work in the transcript too, plus g1–g9, gl (last session), gn (next that needs you). The status bar names the pane: TREE · READ · TYPE.
C · Switcher: a quick ⌃⇥ flips to the last session, holding ⌃ and tapping ⇥ opens a most-recent-first list; ⌥⌘ + arrows move between panes by direction; ⌃⌘1–9 open sessions pinned with p.

Designer's pick: B, with C's ⌃⇥ for the last session. Open questions: ship the Esc change with a “⌘. stops” hint or a setting “Esc stops the turn”; should numbers skip asides and graph steps; C's pins and held switcher later?
